children.description:
According to the market analysis, the probability of Apple stock price going up in the next one day is 42.8%, in the next one week is 32.5%, and in the next one month is 16.8%. The probability of the stock price going down in the next one day is 57.2%, in the next one week is 67.5%, and in the next one month is 83.2%.

Based on the discounted cash flow models and assumptions, the estimated discounted cash flow value of Apple stock is $167.

Please note that these are statistical probabilities and forecasts, and actual stock performance may vary.
